card.title: The Logic Gets Bigger
card.instruction: Use every new detail to expand the impossible system, its history, and the consequences of breaking it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our soup bowl said hello. Use the formal greeting; crockery stopped speaking after the Great Washing-Up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Trade has reopened. Offer a roll, but keep the butter separate; mixed gifts caused the gravy embargo.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's asking for a seat at dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's recognition as a nation. Move the plates apart before we accidentally concede its borders.
